entities.summary: Azerbaijan is a sovereign nation in West Asia, Asia. Its capital is Baku. Official languages include Azerbaijani (Azeri). Government: Unitary semi-presidential republic (de facto authoritarian). Population: approximately 10.2 million. Area: 86,600 km². Comprehensive index for Azerbaijan covering Caucasian Albania, Atropatene, Shirvanshah dynasty, Mongol/Timurid period, Safavid origins (Ardabil), Khanates, Russian conquest (Treaty of Turkmenchay 1828), oil boom (Nobel/Rothschild Baku), ADR 1918 (first secular Muslim republic), Soviet Azerbaijan, Nagorno-Karabakh conflict, independence 1991, Aliyev dynasty, and 2020/2023 Karabakh victories.
